verdict_reason: List/sort/lookup wiring looks sound and is covered by ITs, but @Min(1) on page will 500 because ConstraintViolationException is swallowed by the RuntimeException handler.

todos.issue: @Min(1) on page uses method validation (ConstraintViolationException) but GlobalExceptionHandler only maps MethodArgumentNotValidException to 400 and catches RuntimeException as 500, so GET /notifications?page=0 will 500.
todos.fix: Handle ConstraintViolationException as 400 ProblemDetail and add an HTTP test that page=0 returns 400, not 500.
